newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable after fixing rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable after fixing rate hike.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in late trading on Friday after the central bank increased its fixing rates by two-points, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,405.50/06.00 at 0905 GMT compared with an opening of 2,405.00/06.00.
"The rupiah has remained generally stable as operators appear to be indifferent to whether the central bank hiked its fixing rates by one or two points," one foreign bank dealer said.
Another dealer said the market was briefly surprised by the move, but it remained generally stable.
Bank Indonesia increased its intervention rate by two points to 2,391/2,583 and the conversion rate also by two points to 2,391/2,439 late on Friday.
Another dealer said the rupiah was becoming too liquid with overnight call money hovering as low as 3.0/4.00 percent against an average rate of 5.22 percent on Thursday.
Dealers said the flush liquidity outlook had helped ease short-dated swap rates further.
